title: Clean New Clothes
old_p1: The Lord showed Zechariah Joshua, the high priest. A high priest led the work in the Lord’s house.
Joshua stood before an angel in dirty clothes. The dirty clothes were a picture of wrong things he had done.
The angel said, “Take away the dirty clothes.” He told Joshua, “I have taken your wrong things away.” Then they dressed him in clean clothes!
old_p2: The Lord promised to send “the Branch.” A branch is new growth on a tree. Jesus would come from King David’s family, like a new branch. The Branch is Jesus!
When we are sorry, Jesus helps us feel clean and new inside. He can do that for you too, like fresh new clothes.
p1: The Lord showed Zechariah a remarkable picture. Joshua, the high priest, stood before an angel wearing dirty clothes. They looked so stained and worn.

Then the angel gave a command. The dirty clothes were taken away, and Joshua was dressed in clean ones. What a change! The Lord was showing that He could take away sin and help His people become clean again.
p2: The Lord also promised that someone special would come, like a fresh green branch growing from an old tree. That promised Branch pointed to Jesus Christ.

Because of Jesus, we can turn away from wrong choices and begin again. We can say sorry, try to make things right, and ask for His help. Imagine slipping into soft, clean clothes after a muddy day. Jesus can help your heart feel clean and new too.
note: Levi, 20 Nov 2026 ("Match up the story lantern stories with the published book"): p1 and p2 are the story words AS PRINTED in the published December book (We Have Waited for Him, on Amazon), first and second story page, word for word, so the Lantern, the app's Books page and the book a family bought read the same. The Christian edition reads God for Heavenly Father; p2_christian only where the printed words are Latter-day Saint teaching. The 29 Oct picture-book rewrite is kept as rewrite_p1/rewrite_p2.
rewrite_p1: The Lord showed Zechariah a picture. Joshua, the leader of the priests at the Lord’s house, stood before an angel.
Joshua’s clothes were dirty, a picture of the wrong things he had done.
“Take away the dirty clothes,” the angel said. He told Joshua, “I have taken your wrong things away.” They dressed him in clean clothes and a clean hat!
rewrite_p2: Then the Lord promised to send “the Branch.” A branch is new green growth from an old tree. Jesus would come from King David’s family, like a new branch. The Branch is Jesus!
When we are sorry, Jesus makes us clean and new inside. Tonight, tell Heavenly Father one thing you are sorry for. Then feel brand new!
